summary: Version One Ventures backs mission-driven founders who are early in new areas and says it can make the greatest impact as a seed investor. Its Core Beliefs page states that it typically leads or co-leads with an investment of $500,000 to $1,500,000, often follows on through multiple rounds, and that generational companies are not limited by geography. Sector focus, a formal geography, an application route and a street address are not stated on the pages reviewed.

investmentEvidence.fact: The homepage links a post announcing the investment in Mowito (physical AI for robot arms). The date is not shown on the homepage.
The homepage links a post announcing the investment in Pilot (the internet for agents). The date is not shown on the homepage.
